reason: The plant I already watered does not need watering again, so I will leave it alone and begin the day with the telescope's neighbour, the sky, while the morning is still mine.
Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I will read until I have an answer.
Clay is good and I mean to have a finished piece of it in my collection.
One piece of clay becomes a finished small object, and I will keep it where I can see it.
Energy is wearing thin and a patch of sun is the right place to recover.
Dusk is coming, and the lookout rock is mine to be above things on.
Hunger has come down to 12 and the day is long, so I will eat when the body asks, and spend the afternoon on the clay and the reading I still owe.
